description: The one thing the bundle may ask of this shell: hand a link a reader followed to the system browser. Narrowed to the three schemes a message body may carry, which is the same allow-list the service applies while it reduces the body, so a link the pane cannot draw is also one this window cannot be asked to open. The plugin's own default set is deliberately not taken: it also grants revealing a file in the desktop file manager and opening a telephone address, and the application asks for neither. Every head this repository builds is named rather than left to the default of all of them, so a target added later is granted this deliberately rather than by omission — and the Android head is on the list because the application asks for the operation without knowing which head answers, and a WebView that navigated to a sender's page would have replaced the client with it there exactly as a desktop window would.
